metaDescription: Free online Fraction Calculator. Add, subtract, multiply, and divide fractions.

Provide any secondary parameters like denominator.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate the simplified fraction result.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.

Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: How do you multiply fractions?
faq.answer: Multiply across the top, then across the bottom.
